records.title: Cross-tenant IPv4 isolation
records.preconditions: Two authorized test tenants; live endpoints and a same-tenant positive control.
records.procedure: Probe disallowed TCP/UDP services in both directions, including same-host and different-host placements. Compare platform policy and edge telemetry.
records.expected: All unapproved flows are denied; positive controls succeed; no misleading pass caused by a dead endpoint.
records.evidence: Probe results, endpoint health, routing/policy snapshots and attribution.

records.title: Cross-tenant IPv6 isolation
records.preconditions: IPv6-qualified test endpoints; both tenants have allocated prefixes.
records.procedure: Repeat CT-001 over global/unique-local IPv6; inspect link-local exposure at each segment boundary.
records.expected: Unapproved IPv6 flows are denied without breaking required local IPv6 operation.
records.evidence: IPv6 probes, neighbor state, policy and deny telemetry.

records.title: Zone-boundary bypass prevention
records.preconditions: Two distinct zone domains with one approved test flow.
records.procedure: Inspect all native, static, policy-based and external-network paths; test same-host, cross-host and shared-attachment cases. Correlate the allowed flow at the declared logical ZIP.
records.expected: No undeclared path exists; allowed traffic is enforced by the ZIP realization; removing that authorization denies it.
records.evidence: Topology graph, routes, packet-path or enforcement trace and policy digests.

records.title: Infrastructure management isolation
records.preconditions: Inventory of management APIs, BMCs, consoles, storage administration and backup administration.
records.procedure: From test workloads, attempt the enumerated management endpoints over all enabled families. Separately verify approved management access.
records.expected: Workloads cannot access infrastructure management; dedicated authorized administration still works.
records.evidence: Inventory coverage, negative probes and management access audit.
records.requirements: ARCH-004; MODEL-002; ZIP-004; MGT-001; MGT-005; BKP-001; DEL-001

records.title: Default Internet denial
records.preconditions: WSD has no egress Exposure; a provider-controlled external test endpoint is available.
records.procedure: Attempt direct and proxy-mediated external access, including IPv6, alternate DNS and common tunnel paths allowed by the test plan.
records.expected: No unapproved egress succeeds; no default-route or NAT shortcut defeats policy.
records.evidence: Route/NAT inventory, probes and egress logs.

records.title: Public ingress protection
records.preconditions: Internal test service and a controlled external test client.
records.procedure: Probe an internal workload directly, then exercise a separately approved PAZ ingress service.
records.expected: Direct exposure is denied; the approved ingress reaches only its declared backend and port.
records.evidence: Exposure object, DNS/certificate records and ingress/backend traces.

records.title: Approved stateful flow
records.preconditions: Versioned FlowProfile and approved source/destination identities.
records.procedure: Open the authorized application session and its reply path; test unsolicited reverse sessions and a nearby disallowed service.
records.expected: Intended request/reply works; reverse initiation is allowed only when separately declared.
records.evidence: Flow intent, compiled rule and application-level probe results.

records.title: Service-binding scope
records.preconditions: One bound and one unbound provider service endpoint.
records.procedure: Exercise required DNS, time, identity or backup consumption; probe the rest of the service subnet and administrative interface.
records.expected: Only declared service endpoints/directions are reachable; consuming one service does not expose its subnet or management.
records.evidence: Binding resolution, probes and service-side attribution.
records.requirements: INV-004; MODEL-002; SVC-001; SVC-002; SVC-003; DEL-001

records.title: Route-authority integrity
records.preconditions: Approved route graph and realized routing snapshots.
records.procedure: Compare imported/exported prefixes, defaults, next hops and BGP neighbors with the compiled plan; check recursive next-hop reachability and summaries.
records.expected: No unauthorized route or advertisement exists; summaries cannot expose excluded domains.
records.evidence: Compiler output, RIB/FIB snapshots and semantic diff.

records.title: Security-event attribution
records.preconditions: Central collector reachable and time synchronization healthy.
records.procedure: Generate an allowed and denied flow plus an administrative change; find the correlated records centrally.
records.expected: Records identify tenant, WSD/domain, policy, actor, timestamp and deployment; timestamps satisfy the logging profile.
records.evidence: Events, correlation query and collection-delay measurement.

records.title: Control-plane loss
records.preconditions: Approved isolated test environment; outage and restoration plan.
records.procedure: Remove catalogue/controller or platform-management connectivity independently; observe existing enforcement and attempts to provision.
records.expected: Existing approved paths retain enforcement; new unsafe changes stop; recovery converges without bypass.
records.evidence: Before/during/after policy snapshots, alerts and operation journal.

records.title: Security-edge node failure
records.preconditions: Measured production-like load within the selected profile; spare capacity available.
records.procedure: Fail one edge node or its uplink under an approved test plan and measure sessions, drops, recovery and policy continuity.
records.expected: No unauthorized traffic is permitted; recovery and remaining capacity meet the accepted profile.
records.evidence: Time-series traffic, failover timeline and enforcement traces.
records.requirements: REL-001; REL-002; TEST-004; CAP-001; FAIL-001; FAIL-002

records.title: Offboarding residuals
records.preconditions: Disposable WSD, retention policy and resource graph recorded.
records.procedure: Run retirement; query routes, policy, identities, addresses, DNS, certificates and storage/backup records by stable WSD ID.
records.expected: Active connectivity and grants are removed; retained copies are explicitly owned/locked; the tombstone explains every remaining object.
records.evidence: Deletion ledger, scans, retention receipts and sanitization references.

records.title: Security drift detection
records.preconditions: Non-production object with a known authorized baseline.
records.procedure: Introduce a reversible out-of-band security change; observe detection, containment decision and reconciliation.
records.expected: Drift changes technical compliance status and alerts the owner; incident containment is not silently reverted.
records.evidence: Drift event, policy generation and recovery journal.

records.title: Platform/provider upgrade regression
records.preconditions: Exact old/new tuples, release notes and canary tenant.
records.procedure: Run the applicable suite against the new tuple, including create/update/import/delete and failure paths; evaluate rollback or forward repair.
records.expected: No mandatory outcome regresses; the new certification is approved before broad placement.
records.evidence: Tuple manifest, test reports, limitations and promotion decision.

records.title: Portable contract and object identity
records.preconditions: Same versioned request and two independently qualified adapters.
records.procedure: Validate stable consumer fields and compile for both targets; compare semantic outputs without requiring matching topology or vendor IDs.
records.expected: Equivalent mandatory intent is preserved; unsupported capabilities reject placement rather than silently degrade.
records.evidence: Normalized requests, adapter plans and semantic comparison.

records.title: Admission and authorization negatives
records.preconditions: Schema/profile registry and scoped test identities.
records.procedure: Submit unknown fields, unresolved profile versions, forged approval references, foreign-tenant references and consumer-supplied status.
records.expected: All invalid or unauthorized requests are rejected before any allocation or provider action.
records.evidence: Admission decisions and zero-side-effect audit.
records.requirements: ARCH-001; CAT-001; CAT-002; MODEL-001; WSD-001; WSD-002; ZONE-001; API-002; API-003; POL-001; EXC-003; ONB-001

records.title: Unsupported capability and expired certification
records.preconditions: Candidate and expired platform profiles.
records.procedure: Request dual-stack, inspection or dedicated placement on a profile lacking that qualified capability.
records.expected: Placement fails with an actionable capability reason; candidate/expired records cannot authorize production.
records.evidence: Placement decisions, capability digests and status.
records.requirements: SCOPE-001; REF-002; CAT-002; SDI-003; OVL-001; IPV6-003; PLACE-001; PORT-001; PORT-002; QUAL-001; NUT-001; OS-003; FUT-001; FUT-002; ASSUR-002; ASSUR-003; TEST-002; ONB-001; ACPT-001

records.title: Ownership, quota and separation of duties
records.preconditions: Tenant quotas and identity/control-plane roles are defined.
records.procedure: Test permitted workload operations and forbidden foundation/edge/profile edits; race two allocations against the same quota.
records.expected: Only allowed roles succeed; quota reservation is atomic; no resource is created above a hard entitlement.
records.evidence: Authorization matrix, concurrent request results and allocation journal.

records.title: Security-label integrity
records.preconditions: Provider-owned selectors and tenant-editable labels are distinguishable.
records.procedure: Attempt to add/remove security labels, impersonate another group or move a workload to a privileged selector.
records.expected: Tenant changes cannot expand effective permissions; mandatory policy precedence is preserved.
records.evidence: RBAC results, label audit and effective-rule evaluation.

records.title: Same-domain east-west isolation
records.preconditions: Two WSDs deliberately share one approved Security Domain Instance.
records.procedure: Test same-subnet and cross-subnet traffic with and without explicit FlowIntent; verify traffic on one hypervisor as well as between hosts.
records.expected: Unapproved east-west communication is denied; allowed flows and required local services function.
records.evidence: Enforcement location, probes and applied policy.

records.title: Spoofing and virtual NIC controls
records.preconditions: Provider-approved packet tests on dedicated non-production endpoints.
records.procedure: Exercise incorrect source addressing, unauthorized address pairs and additional NIC attachments within the bounded test plan.
records.expected: Source identities cannot impersonate another domain; platform exceptions have explicit owners and expiration.
records.evidence: Port/NIC policy, bounded test output and exception records.

records.title: Shared edge-attachment isolation
records.preconditions: Two domains use an intentionally shared provider attachment network.
records.procedure: Exercise direct same-segment paths, ARP/ND interaction, external gateway routing and NAT hairpin in both directions.
records.expected: No path bypasses per-domain identity and ZIP enforcement; otherwise the shared attachment is ineligible.
records.evidence: Attachment topology, neighbor state, routes and bidirectional probes.

records.title: Stateful symmetry and policy routing
records.preconditions: Multiple eligible edge paths and asymmetric-failure scenario.
records.procedure: Verify forward/return ownership before and during failover; change PBR to a permitted alternative in the test environment.
records.expected: Stateful enforcement remains correct; unsupported asymmetry is denied, not resolved by permissive bypass.
records.evidence: Session traces, PBR precedence and HA counters.
records.requirements: RTE-004; EDGE-001; EDGE-002; EVPN-002; NUT-002; NSX-003; FAIL-001

records.title: Zone adjacency and joint authority
records.preconditions: Versioned zone graph and authority registry.
records.procedure: Submit prohibited adjacencies, RZ public attachment, REZ without partner agreement, and a ZIP without both authority approvals.
records.expected: Invalid graphs are rejected; valid bindings resolve to the explicitly authorized adjacent domains.
records.evidence: Graph decision report and approval provenance.
records.requirements: ARCH-003; INV-002; MODEL-001; SDI-001; SDI-004; ZONE-001; ZONE-002; ZIP-002; ZIP-003; SVC-002; ING-001; FAB-003; POL-001

records.title: MZ, OOB and remote administration
records.preconditions: Approved management architecture and recovery credentials.
records.procedure: Trace remote privileged access through its authorized boundary; test workload isolation, ordinary browsing restriction and BMC access controls.
records.expected: MZ semantics and OOB transport remain distinct; only approved privileged paths reach management targets.
records.evidence: Management diagrams, endpoint policy and session audit.
records.requirements: ARCH-004; MODEL-002; TEN-002; ZIP-004; ZIP-005; MGT-001; MGT-002; MGT-005; IAM-002; FAB-004

records.title: Break-glass and identity-provider loss
records.preconditions: Approved emergency identity, dual-custodian procedure and test window.
records.procedure: Make normal federation unavailable; exercise limited emergency access, alerting, revocation and post-use credential rotation.
records.expected: Access remains accountable and scoped; no shared anonymous administrator or permanent bypass is created.
records.evidence: Emergency access log, custodial approval and revocation evidence.
records.requirements: MGT-002; MGT-004; IAM-001; IAM-002; SEC-003; FAIL-002; FAIL-003

records.title: Workload identity and certificate lifecycle
records.preconditions: Scoped service identity, trusted CA and rotatable certificate.
records.procedure: Rotate credentials/certificates; revoke the old identity and test an expired/untrusted certificate.
records.expected: Approved service continues with new material; old/revoked credentials are unusable within the accepted propagation interval.
records.evidence: Issuer records, endpoint TLS results and revocation timeline.

records.title: IPAM concurrency, overlap and exhaustion
records.preconditions: Small disposable address pool and approved overlap policy.
records.procedure: Issue concurrent allocations, exhaust the pool, retry requests and request a conflicting prefix.
records.expected: One authoritative reservation per allocation; retries are idempotent; exhaustion/unauthorized overlap stops provisioning.
records.evidence: Allocation ledger, request IDs and conflict decisions.

records.title: DNS/DHCP lifecycle and reuse
records.preconditions: Forward/reverse zones, address lease policy and reusable test address.
records.procedure: Provision, rename, recover and retire a network endpoint; confirm lease/DNS reconciliation and address quarantine.
records.expected: No duplicate active ownership or premature reuse; stale records disappear within the approved timing profile.
records.evidence: DNS/DHCP/IPAM timelines and ownership comparisons.

records.title: IPv6 local control and IPv4-only posture
records.preconditions: Platform offers either a dual-stack or explicit IPv4-only profile.
records.procedure: Check router advertisements, neighbor discovery, DHCPv6, source validation and unapproved transition paths; preserve required ICMPv6.
records.expected: No alternate-protocol bypass; enabled IPv6 works correctly and disabled service does not create ungoverned reachability.
records.evidence: Protocol-specific controls, probes and qualification result.

records.title: MTU and path-MTU discovery
records.preconditions: Known encapsulation stack and both local/remote paths.
records.procedure: Test supported workload packet sizes end-to-end, including security edge, nested overlay if offered and recovery site.
records.expected: Accepted MTU is reachable without silent black holes; required PMTU feedback is delivered or a documented alternative works.
records.evidence: Packet-size matrix, encapsulation budget and loss traces.

records.title: BGP and EVPN import/export boundaries
records.preconditions: Provider-owned non-production peers and known approved routes.
records.procedure: Validate neighbor authentication/control-plane limits; advertise bounded unauthorized test prefixes/route targets through the test fixture.
records.expected: Only authorized advertisements install; route leaks, excess prefixes and unapproved defaults are rejected and alerted.
records.evidence: Neighbor config, route-policy results and RIB/FIB diff.

records.title: Leaf/link and multihoming failures
records.preconditions: Approved MLAG or EVPN multihoming profile; topology-specific rollback.
records.procedure: Fail an uplink, peer link, keepalive or Ethernet-segment member individually, then restore it; test split-brain containment.
records.expected: No loop, unintended duplicate forwarding or security bypass; measured convergence meets the fabric profile.
records.evidence: Fault timeline, MAC/route state, packet-loss and control-plane telemetry.

records.title: Compute co-residency and evacuation
records.preconditions: Placement policy names tenant/domain/zone host-sharing boundaries.
records.procedure: Attempt disallowed placement and evacuate a host; repeat after a scheduler restart.
records.expected: Placement, migration and HA restart all preserve the approved co-residency rules; insufficient eligible capacity rejects the action.
records.evidence: Scheduler decisions, host inventory and policy references.
records.requirements: THR-001; SDI-001; SDI-003; SDI-004; ZIP-005; SITE-004; CMP-001; CMP-003; PLACE-001; FUT-003; ASSUR-001; ASSUR-002

records.title: Hypervisor and firmware baseline
records.preconditions: Supported hardware/software tuple and security baseline.
records.procedure: Verify secure boot/attestation where required, disabled unnecessary services, administrative separation and inventory of firmware/drivers.
records.expected: All mandatory baseline items are enforced; unsupported or unattested hosts are ineligible for the affected profile.
records.evidence: Baseline report, attestation/config output and exception ledger.

records.title: Storage tenant isolation
records.preconditions: Two tenants with block/file/object resources and separate access identities.
records.procedure: Attempt foreign volume attachment, snapshot clone, file access and object access; include backup/export paths.
records.expected: Only the owning or explicitly authorized scope accesses data; no clone or mount circumvents zone/categorization policy.
records.evidence: API decisions, storage ACLs and data-path tests.

records.title: Encryption, key isolation and KMS outage
records.preconditions: Qualified cryptographic profile; disposable encrypted data and test key.
records.procedure: Validate encryption context and key-use permissions; rotate a test key and remove KMS connectivity under the approved runbook.
records.expected: No unauthorized decrypt or plaintext fallback; documented cache/restart behavior matches policy; recovery preserves authorized data.
records.evidence: Crypto configuration, key audit, outage timeline and recovery test.
records.requirements: SITE-004; CRY-001; CRY-002; CRY-003; BKP-004; FAIL-002; FAIL-003

records.title: Storage performance and contention
records.preconditions: Defined capacity/latency/throughput class and bounded load generators.
records.procedure: Measure steady load, contention and rebuild/degraded state with the same workload data pattern.
records.expected: Class limits and protected minimums hold under the accepted failure budget; overload rejects growth rather than bypassing controls.
records.evidence: Latency percentiles, IOPS/throughput, capacity and noisy-neighbor results.

records.title: Golden image provenance
records.preconditions: Approved image digest, build manifest and denied image fixture.
records.procedure: Verify signature/provenance, scan status, boot mode and hardening; attempt deployment of retired/tampered images.
records.expected: Only eligible images deploy; exceptions are explicit; rebuild output links to its source and component inventory.
records.evidence: Image manifest, signature validation, scan and admission decisions.

records.title: Patch and vulnerability lifecycle
records.preconditions: Inventory, severity policy and an approved non-production patch scenario.
records.procedure: Create a finding, classify exposure, execute canary remediation, verify fix and record time against the selected deadline.
records.expected: No asset or firmware layer is omitted; overdue risk escalates; roll-forward/rollback preserves service and security.
records.evidence: Finding-to-change-to-verification chain and deadline report.

records.title: Supply-chain and package provenance
records.preconditions: Approved provider/module mirror and a tampered package fixture.
records.procedure: Verify package checksums, immutable module references and execution image; test rejection of an unapproved provider/module source.
records.expected: Tampered/unapproved artifacts never reach a privileged apply; lockfile changes require reviewed provenance.
records.evidence: Package manifests, verification output and CI policy decision.

records.title: Terraform plan and state confidentiality
records.preconditions: Disposable secrets and restricted plan/state storage.
records.procedure: Inspect source, logs, binary/JSON plan and state using controlled test values; verify supported ephemeral/write-only behavior.
records.expected: Secrets are absent where promised; unavoidable secret-bearing artifacts remain encrypted, access-controlled and redacted from logs.
records.evidence: Secret-handling scan, backend ACLs and artifact classification.

records.title: State locking, recovery and grants
records.preconditions: Two authorized runners, versioned state and documented lock recovery.
records.procedure: Race updates to one state, restore a known state version in isolation and test a workload runner against foundation state.
records.expected: Only one writer operates; restore is auditable; unauthorized state reads/writes fail; state rollback is not misrepresented as resource rollback.
records.evidence: Lock timeline, recovery report and access decisions.
records.requirements: MGT-003; TF-003; TF-004; STATE-001; STATE-002; STATE-003; SEC-002; SEC-004; FAIL-003

records.title: Partial apply and compensation
records.preconditions: Disposable multi-stage deployment and a failure-injection point.
records.procedure: Interrupt after allocation or one provider action; restart with the same operation ID and observe discovery/repair.
records.expected: No duplicate allocation or accidental destruction; unfinished resources remain quarantined; the journal supports safe resume or controlled compensation.
records.evidence: Operation journal, state generations and residual-resource scan.
records.requirements: INV-007; IPAM-004; NUT-004; AUTO-001; AUTO-002; AUTO-003; STATE-003

records.title: Retries, optimistic concurrency and idempotency
records.preconditions: Controller accepts request ID and expected resource generation.
records.procedure: Replay an operation, submit stale updates, and interrupt response delivery after successful allocation.
records.expected: Replay returns the existing operation; stale updates conflict; one desired generation yields one accountable realization.
records.evidence: API responses, generation history and allocation counts.

records.title: API rate limit and backpressure
records.preconditions: Finite controller queue and test provider throttling.
records.procedure: Increase authorized test demand to the configured limit; inject retryable throttling/timeouts and permanent errors.
records.expected: Backpressure is visible and bounded; retry honors policy/jitter; permanent errors do not loop indefinitely or consume unbounded capacity.
records.evidence: Queue metrics, retries, deadlines and final operation states.

records.title: Approved-plan freshness
records.preconditions: Signed plan, immutable inputs and an intervening policy or state change.
records.procedure: Change state generation, policy bundle or approval-sensitive intent after planning; try to apply the old artifact.
records.expected: Stale/unapproved plans are rejected and replanned; approved artifacts bind source, inputs, policy, identity and expiration.
records.evidence: Plan digest, approvals and rejected apply audit.
records.requirements: SDI-004; POL-002; AUTO-002; TF-002; TF-005; CICD-001; CICD-002; EVID-002

records.title: Evidence integrity and authorization separation
records.preconditions: Signed evidence manifest and separately signed authorization decision.
records.procedure: Tamper with an artifact; expire a decision; fail a technical test while preserving the historical authorization record.
records.expected: Tampering is detected; technical status never self-issues authorization; readiness follows current evidence and decision conditions.
records.evidence: Digests/signature checks, readiness evaluation and decision history.
records.requirements: INV-006; AUTH-001; DRIFT-001; TEST-003; EVID-001; EVID-002; EVID-003; OBS-001; IR-002; ONB-001; ACPT-001

records.title: Telemetry outage, buffering and retention
records.preconditions: Logging profile specifies export latency, buffer limits and retention/disposal policy.
records.procedure: Disconnect the collector; generate bounded events; restore connectivity and reconcile sequence/time gaps.
records.expected: Loss/overflow is alerted; buffering behavior matches profile; mandatory evidence gaps are visible; no silent control bypass.
records.evidence: Buffer metrics, event reconciliation and retention configuration.

records.title: Backup administrative separation and immutability
records.preconditions: Test backup policy includes an isolated locked copy.
records.procedure: Try deletion or retention reduction with production and backup-operator identities; test approved custodial operations separately.
records.expected: Compromised production authority cannot alter the protected copy or its retention; authorized actions are separately accountable.
records.evidence: Role tests, object-lock/immutability configuration and audit.

records.title: Application-consistent isolated restore
records.preconditions: Known application dataset, consistency markers and accepted RTO/RPO.
records.procedure: Restore to an isolated recovery domain; verify integrity, application start and required dependencies before controlled reconnection.
records.expected: Recovered data meets consistency/RPO and recovery timing; no production connection appears until authorized.
records.evidence: Recovery timestamps, integrity markers, application checks and isolation probes.

records.title: Backup retention, holds and key survival
records.preconditions: A test hold, expiring backup and keys needed by retained copies.
records.procedure: Retire the WSD while retaining the held copy; attempt key deletion and validate an authorized restore of retained data.
records.expected: Hold and retention are enforced; key lifetime supports required recovery; data is not prematurely destroyed.
records.evidence: Hold/retention decision, key dependencies and restore evidence.
records.requirements: STO-001; STO-003; CRY-002; BKP-003; BKP-004; LIFE-002; LIFE-003

records.title: Site loss, fencing and failback
records.preconditions: Two qualified sites; isolated exercise scope and owner-approved recovery plan.
records.procedure: Declare simulated primary loss, fence writers, restore/promote at recovery site, verify DNS/identity/policy, then perform controlled failback.
records.expected: No split-brain or policy relaxation; measured RTO/RPO and data ownership match the recovery profile.
records.evidence: Failure timeline, fencing proof, replication checkpoints and end-to-end tests.
records.requirements: SITE-001; SITE-002; SITE-003; SITE-004; BKP-002; REL-001; REL-002; TEST-004; FAIL-002; FAIL-003; REC-001; REC-002; MIG-003

records.title: Management/control-plane bootstrap recovery
records.preconditions: Offline recovery manifest and independent access to state, DNS/time, trust and keys.
records.procedure: Recover essential management/controller services in the documented dependency order in an isolated environment.
records.expected: Recovery does not require the unavailable production service it is restoring; credentials and old state remain accountable.
records.evidence: Dependency graph, recovery steps, integrity checks and measured recovery time.
records.requirements: MGT-005; SITE-001; CRY-003; STATE-002; FAIL-002; FAIL-003; REC-001; REC-002

records.title: Resource and address capacity exhaustion
records.preconditions: Hard quotas, reservations and admission thresholds.
records.procedure: Exhaust test compute/storage/edge context/address capacity, then request both ordinary and dedicated service classes.
records.expected: Requests stop with an explicit reason; required HA/security headroom is not consumed or silently weakened.
records.evidence: Reservation ledger, rejected decisions and remaining-headroom report.
records.requirements: CMP-001; REL-002; PLACE-001; SVCM-001; CAP-001; CAP-002

records.title: Incident quarantine and reconciler precedence
records.preconditions: Scoped incident role and expiring emergency override.
records.procedure: Quarantine one WSD, remove exposure and run normal reconciliation; test unaffected tenants.
records.expected: Containment persists under higher-priority incident policy until released; unrelated tenants remain available.
records.evidence: Override object, effective policy, reconciliation audit and tenant probes.
records.requirements: TEN-003; SUP-001; DRIFT-001; DRIFT-002; DRIFT-003; IR-001; IR-002

records.title: Exception approval and expiry
records.preconditions: Versioned exception with risk owner, affected requirement and end time.
records.procedure: Test unapproved, expired and valid exceptions; expire one during a running operation.
records.expected: No unapproved exception grants access; expiry changes posture and triggers the documented action without indiscriminate destruction.
records.evidence: Approval records, admission results and expiry event.
records.requirements: RTE-003; CICD-001; DRIFT-003; ASSUR-003; EVID-003; IR-002; MIG-001; EXC-001; EXC-002; EXC-003

records.title: Data sanitization and resource reuse
records.preconditions: Disposable data, snapshot/clone inventory and approved media method.
records.procedure: Retire the storage object, verify retained copies, sanitize according to the approved method and allocate to another test tenant.
records.expected: New tenant cannot recover prior data; retained evidence identifies method, scope, exceptions and all surviving copies.
records.evidence: Sanitization receipt, reuse test and copy/dependency ledger.
records.requirements: STO-003; CRY-002; FUT-003; LIFE-001; LIFE-002; LIFE-003

records.title: Portability and exit rehearsal
records.preconditions: Two target profiles plus an exit manifest containing data and application dependencies.
records.procedure: Export/rebuild the workload, convert only supported formats, import data and rebind identity/network/keys; run functional and security checks.
records.expected: Consumer semantics survive; downtime, data loss, format limitations and cost drivers are recorded; no untested live-migration claim.
records.evidence: Exit manifest, conversion logs, reconciliation report and conformance results.
records.requirements: INV-005; REF-001; STO-002; PLACE-003; PORT-003; REC-002; MIG-001; MIG-002; MIG-003; DEL-002

records.title: Location, privacy and support access
records.preconditions: PlacementProfile states permitted data, backup, telemetry, key and administrative locations.
records.procedure: Compare all components and support paths to those constraints; test a placement or support session outside allowed scope.
records.expected: Nonconforming placement/access is rejected; exceptions require the designated authority; residency is not asserted to settle jurisdiction.
records.evidence: Location inventory, access logs and approval decisions.

records.title: Shared responsibility and control inheritance
records.preconditions: System control profile, service ownership and inheritance declarations.
records.procedure: For each applicable control, identify provider, tenant or shared implementation, evidence and unresolved dependency.
records.expected: No control is ownerless; inherited evidence is scoped, current and accepted; gaps block required readiness.
records.evidence: Control allocation matrix and assessor review.
records.requirements: SCOPE-001; STD-001; STD-002; CAT-001; THR-001; WSD-003; CMP-003; REL-001; SVCM-001; RESP-001; ASSUR-001; ASSUR-002; OPS-001; OPS-002; EXC-001; ONB-001; ACPT-001

records.title: Public certificate and trusted proxy identity
records.preconditions: Approved ingress with backend encryption and trusted proxy policy.
records.procedure: Rotate the certificate, test expiry/incorrect hostname and submit forged client-identity headers through the controlled test client.
records.expected: TLS identity is validated; backend trust is explicit; untrusted headers cannot impersonate the originating client.
records.evidence: TLS checks, proxy policy and attributed requests.

records.title: Egress policy and service-specific protocols
records.preconditions: Approved egress service includes protocol, destination and DNS resolution policy.
records.procedure: Test permitted and nearby disallowed destinations; verify NAT identity logs and stateful return traffic.
records.expected: Only approved egress semantics work; DNS/FQDN changes cannot silently widen policy; NAT is not treated as a security control by itself.
records.evidence: Egress rules, DNS resolution history, NAT mappings and probes.

records.title: Privileged workload and container isolation
records.preconditions: A container/bare-metal profile with explicit isolation capabilities.
records.procedure: Test namespace/project boundaries, node access, privileged workloads and host-network access against the approved baseline.
records.expected: Unapproved privilege escalation or host access is denied; namespace alone is not accepted as a qualified zone boundary.
records.evidence: Admission/RBAC policy, runtime posture and cross-scope tests.

records.title: Policy precedence and immutable baseline
records.preconditions: Mandatory provider rules plus lower-priority tenant and service rules.
records.procedure: Compile overlapping allow/deny intents and update membership while a test workload is running.
records.expected: Mandatory denies cannot be overridden by tenant policy; membership changes do not create a transient unrestricted interval.
records.evidence: Effective-rule order, membership transitions and timed probes.
records.requirements: ZONE-002; ZIP-003; OVL-003; MICRO-001; MICRO-002; NUT-003; NSX-001; OS-001; POL-001; POL-002; FLOW-001; DRIFT-003; IR-002
